name: HarborTrack
decisions: Follow user-supplied FleetTrack desktop and mobile Instagram references viewed in authorised browser
Compact top navigation with full navigation drawer
White panels and orange container hero; mobile two-column summary and stacked cargo detail
Keep operational numbers backed by database records
Order-first dashboard selector: one card per order, updating progress, items and all connected containers
Order workspace combines item entry, shipping details, containers, documents, progress and receiving without separate shipment navigation
Waiting to receive uses an inline confirmation checkbox and submit button; completion is validated on the server
